ResultList.divRecTypeLong:
A Diversion Comment potentially contains the following information: a 
“not used” code (NUC); and/or,
a general comment regarding the structure.
Total amount of water diverted by structure

A Release Comment potentially contains the following information: 
a “not released” code (NRC); and/or,
a general comment regarding the structure.
Total amount of water released by structure

A Water Class consists of a series of codes that provide the location of the diversion, the SOURCE of water, the USE of the water and the administrative operation required to make a diversion or release.
